system.description:
• Effect: As part of your action on your turn, lunge for a second strike — make one additional melee attack this round, usable a number of times per day equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum 1/day). This is an extra attack, rolled with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • This is the reliable way to feed Relentless Assault a second hit without waiting on an enemy to miss — Riposte and Perfect Parry still work too, and all three can set up the same round's stacking bonus.

activities.name: Flèche
activities.text: One additional melee attack this round as part of your action, with Disadvantage (an extra attack).
